subject: POC planning & success criteria — Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: POC planning & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Hi Tom — thanks for the demo and the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff:

Call recap:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for product search ranking and generative suggestions in the Stellar storefront.
- Scope: 2-week POC evaluating latency, throughput, and relevance on a 100k product subset + 5 key prompts.

Proposed success criteria (attached: stellar_poc_success_criteria.xlsx):
1) Avg 95th percentile latency < 300ms for interactive queries at target QPS (~20 qps).
2) End-to-end relevance lift: +10% CTR on top-3 suggested results in A/B test vs baseline.
3) Stable KV cache working with your product embeddings and ability to serve context from S3.
4) Clear operational runbook and owner for rollout.

Timeline / next steps:
- Week of Jul 19: Kickoff and data handoff (you to provide sample exports and S3 signed URL access).
- Jul 19–Aug 1: 2-week POC (SE + Engineer support from Redwood).
- Aug 2: Wrap / findings / exec summary.

Owners:
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra (cc’d) — technical lead and integration owner.
- Customer PM: Tom Keller — POC sign-off and data owner.

Risks / unknowns to confirm:
- Data access: we need temporary signed URLs (or S3 role) for ingestion.
- Security questionnaire: your security contact to share the SOC2 items if needed.

Please confirm the timeline and that Priya (if she’s on the thread) is the right engineering contact for the data handoff. If that works, we’ll schedule the kickoff for Mon Jul 19 at 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: stellar_poc_success_criteria.xlsx, poc_onboarding_checklist.pdf

- Security: our security lead is Nadia Ortiz (nortiz@stellar-commerce.com). She may request the SOC2 documentation — happy to loop her in.

—Tom

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellar-commerce.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Tom — great, thanks. Short answers and an updated plan below.

S3 & ingestion:
- We can ingest from pre-signed URLs if the links have at least 24 hours TTL and the file list is provided in a manifest. If the signed-URL approach is brittle for you, we can accept a one-time upload to a customer-provided bucket with cross-account role.

Updated POC plan (attached checklist):
- Jul 19 (10am PT): Kickoff (introductions, data handoff).
- Jul 20–22: Data ingestion & mapping (Redwood + Priya).
- Jul 23–30: Integration + model tuning; daily stand-ups as needed.
- Jul 31–Aug 1: Test runs, metrics collection, wrap & exec summary.

Owners and escalation path:
- SE lead: Rishi Malhotra — primary technical owner for integration (rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com).
- PM / commercial: Marissa Cole — contractual and timeline owner.
- Engineering escalation: Dev Patel (cc’d) — for any blocking infra/engineer issues.

I’ve created a shared risk/issue tracker (link below) for any blockers we discover during ingestion or testing — we’ll update it daily.

Let me know if you want me to include a short security packet for Nadia ahead of the kickoff.

—Marissa

Attachments: poc_onboarding_checklist.pdf
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cStellarPOC

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tkeller@stellar-commerce.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellar-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning & success criteria — Stellar Commerce

Internal note / initial risk flag (adding to tracker):

Summary:
- During a pre-kickoff dry run ingestion, we attempted to fetch the sample context files via the pre-signed S3 URLs provided by Priya. Several files returned 403 intermittently and the downloader hung on multipart boundaries (see attached s3_signed_url_debug_log.txt).

Impact:
- If the signed URLs intermittently fail, Redwood’s ingestion job will retry but this could delay initial data mapping by 24–72 hours depending on retry/backoff. The POC timeline may slip by up to 2–3 business days without mitigation.

Mitigations / next steps:
1) Temporary workaround: Priya can upload a one-time tarball to a customer-provided bucket with a cross-account role (preferred) OR provide signed URLs with >=72 hours TTL to avoid expiry during transfer.
2) Redwood action: Engineering will add a more robust retry and multipart boundary handling patch; tentative ETA for hotfix is 48 hours after we open JIRA-ENG-2345. Dev, can you triage and confirm?
3) If we hit further issues, we escalate to infra on-call and propose a brief 1-hour tech session with Priya to walk through logs.

I’ll update the shared tracker entry: JIRA-ENG-2345 (internal) / link: JIRA-ENG-2345.

—Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@stellar-commerce.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellar-commerce.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nortiz@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff update — temporary delay & mitigation plan

Tom / Priya / Nadia — quick update before the kickoff tomorrow.

We ran into an ingestion issue during a dry run: some pre-signed S3 URLs are returning intermittent 403s which is blocking our automated ingestion. Rishi and the engineering team have identified the cause as multipart handling combined with short TTLs on a subset of URLs.

Impact:
- Expected delay to ingestion: 48–72 hours if we continue using the current signed-URL set. The rest of the POC activities (model tuning, metrics collection) depend on successful ingestion.

Temporary mitigation options (please confirm which you prefer):
1) Customer-side (recommended): Priya uploads a single tarball of the dataset to your customer bucket and grants Redwood a cross-account read role for 72 hours. This avoids signed-URL expiry issues and speeds ingestion.
2) Customer-side alternative: regenerate signed URLs with >=72 hour TTL and provide a manifest (we will ingest sequentially).
3) Redwood-side: we can run a hotfix to improve retry/multipart handling (Rishi estimates ~48 hours to deploy once ENG triages JIRA-ENG-2345).

Please reply with your preferred mitigation. If you approve option 1 we can proceed immediately and keep kickoff on Jul 19 with a short update call to confirm ingestion complete.

Attachments: s3_signed_url_debug_log.txt

Thanks — we want to minimize slip and will keep daily updates to the risk tracker.

—Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Keller <tkeller@stellar-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellar-commerce.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nortiz@stellar-commerce.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff update — temporary delay & mitigation plan

Thanks for the heads up — we’ll do option 1 (one-time tarball + cross-account role). Priya will upload the tarball today and I’ll have Nadia approve any security questions.

Keep me posted on the hotfix status but go ahead with ingestion as soon as the tarball is available. We still plan to join the Jul 19 kickoff; if ingestion completes earlier, great.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

—Tom
